wire.headline: Energy firm reports profit drop and job cuts as shares fall
sentences: Revenue increased by 7% year on year to reach 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to 310m GBP.
The company announced 850 job cuts, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, one located in Wales and one in Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.
Shares fell by 4.2% during morning trading.
